$comment: The one list of configurable things. server/config.py validates the TOML against it and fills defaults from it; frontend/src/keymap.js and settings.js import it for the same defaults. Chord syntax: optional modifiers Mod (Ctrl or Cmd), Ctrl, Cmd, Alt, Shift, then one key, joined by '+'. Contexts: 'flight' = pointer locked, 'free' = pointer released, 'overview' = Tab overview. Two actions may share a chord only if their contexts never overlap. `user: true` marks what a signed-in user may override for themselves (server/account.py): the value here and in /admin is then the default they start from.

keybinds.label: Take the pointer back and fly
Show or hide the key list
Fly back to before the last jump
Hold, move the mouse onto a look, let go: Deep Space, Deep Sea, Terminal, Minimal, Shallow Space
Lay the map out round the targeted star (Ctrl+Z goes back)
Show the path between two stars: press on one, then on the other
Rename the targeted star or link
Connect two stars: press on one, then on the other
Hold, move the mouse onto a layout shape, let go: Cone, Flat, Off (balances with it)
Save with a new name or password

settings.label: Mouse sensitivity
settings.help: How far the view turns per mouse movement. 1 is the original feel.

settings.label: Invert mouse Y
settings.help: Mouse forward looks down, like a flight stick.

settings.label: Base flight speed
settings.help: World units per second at 1.00x, before the scroll wheel multiplier.

settings.label: Top scroll speed
settings.help: The highest multiplier the scroll wheel can reach.

settings.label: Starting look
settings.help: Deep Space: everything moving. Shallow Space: the same stars and sky, standing still. Deep Sea: the ocean. Terminal: abstract data, hacker green. Minimal: plain orbs, nothing animated, fastest. Picking one with V keeps it: in this browser, or in the account when signed in.

settings.label: Dust rivers
settings.help: Dust that orbits stars and flows along links.

settings.label: Supernova on delete
settings.help: A flash and shockwave when a star is deleted.

settings.label: Star brightness
settings.help: Multiplies how bright stars are. 1 is the original.

settings.label: Bloom strength
settings.help: Share of star light spread out as glow.

settings.label: Label distance
settings.help: Multiplies how far away star names appear. Higher shows more names at once.

settings.label: Names at once
settings.help: About how many star names to show at once. Names reach further out until about this many are on screen; label distance sets the nearest they ever stop.

settings.label: Connection heat
settings.help: Colour links by how connected their stars are, cool blue to hot red. H switches it in the map.

settings.label: Largest file Open accepts (MB)
settings.help: Uploads over this are refused before they're read.

settings.label: Accounts
settings.help: Lets people sign up and keep their maps on this server. Over plain HTTP (no HTTPS and no TLS proxy counted in Reverse proxies in front) they are warned before signing in, since passwords and maps then cross the network unencrypted.

settings.label: Open sign-up
settings.help: Anyone who can reach the server may create an account while this is on.

settings.label: Maps per account
settings.help: Creating or duplicating a map past this is refused.

settings.label: Shortest account password
settings.help: Applies to new passwords only.

settings.label: Admin session length (minutes)
settings.help: Sign-in lasts this long, or until the tab closes.

settings.label: Wrong passwords before lockout
settings.help: Per client address, and per username for account sign-in.

settings.label: Lockout length (minutes)
settings.help: How long an address waits after too many wrong passwords.

settings.label: Reverse proxies in front
settings.help: How many X-Forwarded-For hops to trust for the client address. 0 when browsers connect directly; 1 behind Caddy.

settings.label: Networks allowed to reach /admin
settings.help: CIDR ranges, one per line. Anything else gets a 404. The default allows everyone (password only).
